tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Light: paper. Dark: jamun night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs, on bg.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Jamun mist: chips, avatar discs, icon tiles and the empty part of progress bars. Replaces Pop's pink tint so raspberry is the only pink on screen.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px card outlines and dividers. Decorative only, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, unselected chips and secondary buttons; at least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg, surface and surface-subtle. Jamun ink, replacing navy.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, metadata and helper text on bg, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Screen titles, card titles and the greeting, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Raspberry: the one hero surface per screen, such as the portfolio card or the garden.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand. No muted tone passes on raspberry, so it stays white.

tokens.name: money
tokens.usage: The hero amount on brand, set in type-display-xl.

tokens.name: brand-divider
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a brand surface.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Raspberry as text on bg and surface. Lightened in dark mode to stay readable. Not the wordmark: that is wordmark-ink.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the main button on bg and surface. One per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Jamun fill of the button that sits on the raspberry hero card.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Sunshine label on action.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Jamun: nudges, approvals, toasts, selected chips and full-screen moments such as onboarding and payment success.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: on-secondary-muted
tokens.usage: Lilac: secondary text and idle icons on secondary.

tokens.name: on-secondary-accent
tokens.usage: Sunshine: icons, highlights and text buttons on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-divider
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a secondary surface.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Parent app tab bar. Jamun in light mode, raised night in dark mode.

tokens.name: nav-border
tokens.usage: Top edge of the tab bar; only visible in dark mode.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Sunshine: the selected tab's icon and label on nav-bg.

tokens.name: nav-idle
tokens.usage: Lilac: unselected tabs on nav-bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected marks on bg and surface, such as the tab underline. Not for body text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Sunshine. Only ever on jamun or raspberry, never on paper or white.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a highlight fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind a BottomSheet.

tokens.name: wordmark-ink
tokens.usage: Letters of the live-text Wordmark on bg: jamun ink in light mode, white in dark mode. Same inks as the logo files in Logos.

tokens.name: wordmark-dot
tokens.usage: The dot of the live-text Wordmark on bg: raspberry in light mode (matches nuberry-wordmark-primary), sunshine in dark mode (matches nuberry-wordmark-reversed).

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Filled part of goal and lesson progress bars, on surface-subtle.

tokens.name: kids-surface
tokens.usage: Background of Penny and child-world cards.

tokens.name: on-kids-surface
tokens.usage: Text on kids-surface.

tokens.name: kids-label
tokens.usage: Penny's name and kid-world labels on kids-surface.

tokens.name: kids-avatar
tokens.usage: Penny's avatar disc and child-world badges.

tokens.name: on-kids-avatar
tokens.usage: Letter or icon on kids-avatar.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success and gains on bg and surface, always with a word or a + sign.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors, losses and failed payments on bg and surface, always with a word or a sign.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the warning Note.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Icon colour in the warning Note, on warning-surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset, on bg, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: focus-on-brand
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls on brand, secondary and the tab bar.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (equity) on surface. Charts always carry a legend.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (debt) on surface.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series (hybrid) on surface.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series (global, other) on surface.

tokens.name: qr-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind a QR code. White in both themes: many scanners can't read a light-on-dark code.

tokens.name: qr-fg
tokens.usage: QR code modules, on qr-bg. Dark in both themes.

styles.name: type-display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero amount per screen.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Start a SIP in your child's name, in a few minutes.

styles.name: type-body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside copy and key values.

styles.name: type-body-s
styles.sample: Aanya finished “Why we save” this week.

styles.name: type-micro
styles.usage: Nav labels and eyebrows. Nothing smaller.

styles.name: type-digits
styles.usage: OTP boxes and MPIN keypad digits. Figtree, never Baloo.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Only the gap between AllocationBar segments. Not a layout step; never use it for padding or gaps elsewhere.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and icon-plus-label pairs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero card padding and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a new section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Onboarding top spacing.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Marketing page section padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small badges and inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero brand card and the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, progress bars.
